758:t_1:1011.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't say that. A journey's better with company.」

758:t_1:1012.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Got it. I'm pretty excited about this new world myself.」

758:t_1:1013.en:
$$隼人$$
「For $$ゲッター線$$ research, too, heading out into space and using this $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ would probably be the most efficient.」

758:t_1:1014.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Enough with the fancy talk! I'm counting on you two again, pals!」

758:t_1:1015.en:
$$渓$$
「A hyperdimensional world... That's where our new battle begins, huh.」

758:t_1:1016.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Whatever is waiting for us, all we do is move forward.」

758:t_1:1017.en:
$$號$$
(That's right. That will of yours is what calls forth the future... evolution...)

758:t_1:1018.en:
$$號$$
(Guided by the $$ゲッター線$$, Earth's humanity now takes its first step into a new stage...)

758:t_1:1022.en:
$$つばさ$$
「...You've already made up your mind, haven't you?」

758:t_1:1024.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'm thinking of joining the outer space expedition team with $$マジンガーＺ$$.」

758:t_1:1025.en:
$$つばさ$$
「Is that because of $$ゼウス$$?」

758:t_1:1026.en:
$$甲児$$
「During the $$超時空修復$$, $$ゼウス$$ told me he'd be waiting in the vast universe, and then went away... Part of it is that those words stayed with me.」

758:t_1:1027.en:
$$甲児$$
「But that's not all. Inside me, there's a feeling that I want to go once more to that sea of galaxies I saw in that battle.」

758:t_1:1030.en:
$$つばさ$$
「Alright. Leave $$シロー$$ and your father to me.」

758:t_1:1032.en:
$$つばさ$$
「By the time you're back from outer space, $$シロー$$ will be a full-fledged man and your father will have woken up, I'd bet.」

758:t_1:1034.en:
$$さやか$$
「Of course, I'm coming along too.」

758:t_1:1036.en:
$$さやか$$
「Because... if I sit around waiting, I might end up an old lady...」

758:t_1:1037.en:
$$ボス$$
「Just so you know, I'm going too!」

758:t_1:1039.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「If you decide on the spur of the moment, you'll regret it!」

758:t_1:1040.en:
$$ボス$$
「You idiots! The world stretches beyond space, all the way to other dimensions! How can I stay on Earth forever!?」

758:t_1:1041.en:
$$ボス$$
「The sea of space is my sea! To make real men of ourselves, we're going too!」

758:t_1:1043.en:
$$さやか$$
「Let's keep working together from now on, too, $$甲児$$.」

758:t_1:1044.en:
$$ボス$$
「We're not letting you play the hero all by yourself forever!」

758:t_1:1045.en:
$$安$$
「Now that it's settled, this calls for a celebration...!」

758:t_1:1046.en:
$$クロス$$
「Let's throw a party to celebrate the young folks setting out.」

758:t_1:1047.en:
$$お菊$$
「Take care of yourselves, young master, young miss.」

758:t_1:1048.en:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「Going out into space makes you Earth's representatives. Do us proud.」

758:t_1:1050.en:
$$ローレライ$$
「$$先生$$ says he'll go all out on the cooking, too.」

758:t_1:1051.en:
$$シロー$$
「Do your best, Big Bro! I'll protect Mom, Dad, and $$くろがね屋$$!」

758:t_1:1053.en:
$$甲児$$
(Wait for me, $$ゼウス$$... and everyone in $c, too... I'm going out into the vast universe with $$マジンガー$$ as well.)

758:t_1:1054.en:
$$甲児$$
(Where there is hope, light is born... I'll light up humanity's future with the light of hope.)

758:t_1:1059.en:
$$谷川$$
「$$赤木$$-chan... your sighing is annoying.」

758:t_1:1060.en:
$$中原$$
「You've been doing it nonstop since a while ago.」

758:t_1:1061.en:
$$赤木$$
「This mountain of paperwork... I have to get it all done today. Of course I'm sighing...」

758:t_1:1063.en:
$$石塚$$
「PR Section 2's job isn't only running $$ダイ・ガード$$, you know.」

758:t_1:1064.en:
$$田口$$
「Properly putting past damage from $$界震$$s and other disasters into data... That's an important job too.」

758:t_1:1065.en:
$$伊集院$$
「It's important. Be prepared and you've nothing to fear.」

758:t_1:1067.en:
$$横沢$$
「Use your hands before you use your mouth. If it's not done today, it's overtime.」

758:t_1:1070.en:
$$大杉$$
「Yes, that very 'could it be' - a $$界震$$ alert. As a precaution, PR Section 2 has been ordered to stand by at the site.」

758:t_1:1071.en:
$$赤木$$
「All right! Let's go, $$いぶき$$, $$青山$$!」

758:t_1:1072.en:
$$青山$$
「Look at him, all fired up...」

758:t_1:1073.en:
$$いぶき$$
「You'd never guess he was sighing over a pile of paperwork until a minute ago.」

758:t_1:1074.en:
$$赤木$$
「$$ダイ・ガード$$ exists to protect the peace! If I don't get fired up when peace is in danger, what am I supposed to do!?」

758:t_1:1075.en:
$$大杉$$
「A-$$赤木$$, take as much of the paperwork as you can to the site and work on it while on standby.」

758:t_1:1077.en:
$$青山$$
「Of course. The deadline is today, after all.」

758:t_1:1078.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Come on, you've got no time to be down. Go get 'em, $$赤木$$.」

758:t_1:1079.en:
$$赤木$$
「Damn it! If that's how it is, I'll take on the paperwork and the $$ヘテロダイン$$ all at once!」

758:t_1:1080.en:
$$青山$$
「So in the end, it comes to that... The world changed, but $$赤木$$ never does...」

758:t_1:1081.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Isn't that fine? It's so like you, $$赤木$$... no, so like all of us.」

758:t_1:1082.en:
$$佐伯$$
「What are you doing, everyone!? The sortie order has already been issued!」

758:t_1:1083.en:
$$城田$$
「I'm counting on you. The site is near a residential area, and the evacuation isn't going well.」

758:t_1:1084.en:
$$赤木$$
「Leave it to us, $$城田$$. We in PR Section 2 are allies of justice.」

758:t_1:1085.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's go, everyone! Straight down the path of hot-blooded justice with the $c spirit!」

758:t_1:1086.en:
$$赤木$$
「Salarymen can protect the peace too!」

758:t_1:1090.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「You're late, $$カレン$$! The graduation ceremony's about to start!」

758:t_1:1091.en:
$$カレン$$
「Safe by a hair! And my credits, too!」

758:t_1:1092.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「Still, it's strange. Of everyone, only you and I end up graduating from the academy.」

758:t_1:1094.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「What are you going to do after you graduate, $$カレン$$? You didn't take any entrance exams...」

758:t_1:1096.en:
$$カレン$$
「I know. You're going after Council President $$ミレイ$$ to become an AD at a TV station.」

758:t_1:1099.en:
$$カレン$$
「I haven't decided, but I intend to look for what I can do for Japan in this new world.」
